assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone transparent achievement icon for a friendly retro farm sheep game.
Subject: a cheerful cream-white sheep standing beside a tiny low warm-brown wooden pasture gate with ONE pink blossom attached. The sheep is dominant and immediately readable, with a cute peach-pink face and brown hooves, plus one simple green leaf near the gate.
Style/medium: flat 2D pixel sprite on a 32x32 logical pixel grid enlarged using nearest-neighbor, a few solid flat colors, thick dark orange-brown stepped outlines, clean large square pixel clusters. Readable at 28px.
Composition: a single compact square cutout centered in a square image with 12 percent true transparent margin on all sides, all parts fully inside the image. Sheep and tiny gate together make one clear coherent silhouette.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no backdrop.
Avoid: text, digits, logo, watermark, grid, multiple icons, background, ground rectangle, 3D, gradients, soft shadows, blur or anti-aliasing.
